name: Triple oversold-confluence: fear + funding flush + RSI floor (sentiment must add beyond price)
rationale: Thesis: combine a PRICE-oversold axis (rsi below a floor, bounded 0-100) with two NON-price stress axes — crowd sentiment (fear_greed extreme-low) and leverage capitulation (funding_rate flushed). The hypothesis is the Extremity-Premium claim that sentiment carries information BEYOND price-based oversold: requiring all three should isolate true exhaustion from a routine RSI dip that mean-reverts weakly. Long-only spot, short-to-medium hold. Disconfirmer: must beat (a) rsi-floor ALONE and (b) the fear+rsi pair on deflated Sharpe after fees — if RSI-alone matches, the sentiment/funding axes are redundant with price and we have re-derived a tired oversold-RSI signal. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: RSI oversold coinciding with extreme fear and a funding flush
